pattern_race: In independent fair coin tosses, every prescribed string of five outcomes at a fixed starting position has probability 1/32.
cyclic_words: The number of labeled length-20 binary strings with exactly eight 1s before imposing any run restriction is binomial(20,8).
grid_trees: The grid graph is bipartite under the coloring (i+j) modulo 2.
ballot_paths: Every unrestricted path to (12,12) has exactly 12 north steps and 12 east steps.
primitive_triples: For any such triple without the gcd restriction, (a+2b+3c)+(3a+2b+c)=240.
regular_bipartite: Every admissible matrix has exactly ten entries equal to one.
